picks.thesis: Genuine convergence: a congressional cluster (Gilbert Cisneros x3, Julia Letlow, Richard W. Allen; 5 filings, tx dates Jan 30-Feb 26 2026) sits alongside a broad, fresh insider buying cluster - 19 open-market purchases from 21 distinct TSM executives, including Chairman/CEO Wei Che-Chia, none flagged as 10b5-1 plans, running from June 5 through Aug 3 2026 (the most recent filed with only a 1-day lag). The insider side is current; the congressional filings are stale (~6 months old) but establish the pattern first. Individual insider buy sizes are modest (~$3k-11k each), congressional bands run to $250k.
key_risks: The congressional filings underpinning the cluster are roughly 6 months old (tx dates Jan-Feb 2026) - disclosure lag means current congressional sentiment is unconfirmed
Individual insider purchase amounts are small relative to executive comp, limiting how much conviction each single filing carries
Price is already up 6.34% over 5 days and down 7.66% over 30 days - some of the move may be priced in
picks.invalidation: The insider buying cluster stops and TSM executives begin filing sales, or price breaks below the 90-day low of 374.67 while insider activity stays quiet.

picks.thesis: A 3-member congressional cluster - April McClain Delaney (9 separate TDG buys, Apr-Jul 2026), Gilbert Cisneros (1 buy, Mar 2026), and Alan Armstrong (1 buy) - accumulated TDG stock across 14 filings, with committee alignment flagged for Delaney against the aerospace/defense sector tag. The most recent filing (Delaney, tx Jul 28, filed Aug 3, lag 6 days) is fresh, but the Armstrong filing is extremely stale (116-day filing lag). One of the three cluster members (Armstrong) filed 116 days late, undermining timeliness of that leg
One buyer (Delaney) accounts for 9 of the 14 filings, so the 'cluster' is concentrated in a single dominant filer
picks.invalidation: Cluster members file TDG sales, or no further buys appear from this group over the next several disclosure cycles while price continues declining.

Congressional position sizes are small (bands top out at $15,000)
